verdict.rationale: Eqvista is a web-based equity management SaaS, and a product of this kind could plausibly offer an API or CLI for scripted, headless use, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no API, CLI, SDK or CI integration, only UI-driven workflows, spreadsheet import, white-glove migration and downloadable reports. The llms.txt file describes the product to AI readers but does not enable headless operation.
